## Analysis of experimental IMT distributions


```{r}
if(!'devtools' %in% installed.packages()) install.packages('devtools')
if(!require('diprate')) devtools::install_github("QuLab-VU/dipDRC", subdir="diprate", dependencies=TRUE)
```

### Load data
```{r}
f <- list.files('../../Data/exp_cell_counts_raw', full.names = TRUE)

conds <- paste(sapply(strsplit(basename(f), "_"), "[[", 2), sapply(strsplit(basename(f), "_"), "[[", 3))
conds <- gsub(".csv","",conds)
conds
```

```{r}
d <- lapply(f, function(x) read.csv(x, header = FALSE))

```
